endpoints.type:
@FiniteDistribution.outcome_expectation_prob
     : forall (A X : Type) (n : nat) (mu : Representation.SubEnumQ X)
         (k : X -> PTreeDefinition.ptree Sum.void1 Representation.SubEnumQ A)
         (f : Runner.outcome A -> ssrnum.Num.NumDomain.sort rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_NumDomain),
       @FiniteDistribution.outcome_expectation A (S n)
         {|
           PTreeDefinition._observe :=
             @PTreeDefinition.ProbF Sum.void1 Representation.SubEnumQ A
               (PTreeDefinition.ptree Sum.void1 Representation.SubEnumQ A) X mu k
         |} f =
       @ssralg.GRing.add
         (ssrnum.Num.NumDomain.Exports.Num_NumDomain__to__GRing_Nmodule
            rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_NumDomain)
         (@FiniteEnum.finite_expect rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_NumDomain X
            (fun x : X => @FiniteDistribution.outcome_expectation A n (k x) f)
            (@Representation.subenumQ_data X mu))
         (@ssralg.GRing.mul
            (ssralg.GRing.Ring.Exports.GRing_Ring__to__GRing_SemiRing
               rat.rat_rat__canonical__GRing_Ring)
            (@ssralg.GRing.add
               (ssralg.GRing.SemiRing.Exports.GRing_SemiRing__to__GRing_Nmodule
                  (ssralg.GRing.Ring.Exports.GRing_Ring__to__GRing_SemiRing
                     rat.rat_rat__canonical__GRing_Ring))
               (ssralg.GRing.one
                  (ssralg.GRing.Ring.Exports.GRing_Ring__to__GRing_SemiRing
                     rat.rat_rat__canonical__GRing_Ring))
               (@ssralg.GRing.opp rat.rat_rat__canonical__GRing_Zmodule
                  (@Representation.enumQ_mass X (@Representation.subenumQ_raw X mu))))
            (f (@Runner.Lost A)))

endpoints.name: PTree.Execution.Backend.UniformReplay.replay_prob_cons
endpoints.type:
@UniformReplay.replay_prob_cons
     : forall (A X : Type) (n : nat) (mu : Representation.SubEnumQ X)
         (k : X -> PTreeDefinition.ptree Sum.void1 Representation.SubEnumQ A)
         (i : nat) (tail : list nat),
       @Runner.run Representation.SubEnumQ (list nat) (@RationalTickets.ticket_replay) A
         (S n)
         {|
           PTreeDefinition._observe :=
             @PTreeDefinition.ProbF Sum.void1 Representation.SubEnumQ A
               (PTreeDefinition.ptree Sum.void1 Representation.SubEnumQ A) X mu k
         |} (i :: tail)%list =
       (if ssrnat.leq (S i) (@RationalTickets.ticket_count X mu)
        then
         match @RationalTickets.draw_ticket X mu i with
         | @Some _ x =>
             @Runner.run Representation.SubEnumQ (list nat) (@RationalTickets.ticket_replay) A n
               (k x) tail
         | @None _ => (@Runner.Lost A, tail)
         end
        else (@Runner.EntropyExhausted A, tail))
